body:
With `CYTHON_USE_MODULE_STATE=1`, an extension containing a default memoryview argument fails to compile: the generated traversal accesses `memview` through `->`, although the stored value is a `__Pyx_memviewslice` struct. Use `.` for that field access.

The existing `cyfunction_defaults` memoryview defaults fail to compile on master a76568d with module state enabled and pass with this fix in C and C++17. With module state enabled, the repository runner passed 35 tests for `cyfunction_defaults` and the unchanged `reimport_module_state` fixture in C and C++17.

Without an explicit C++ standard, module-state builds also fail on master with an unrelated `std::atomic` initialization error, so the C++ run used C++17.

comment_data.body:
This doesn't feel like the right place for this test. I'm generally in favour of reusing test files where possible (just to save compilation time) but this one feels like it's specifically testing re-imports and that isn't really what the PR is about.

I was going to enable a general module state test run, and I'm fairly sure this will be covered by something in our existing tests, so maybe we don't need to add anything for this PR.

     return CYTHON_USE_MODULE_STATE
 
+from array import array
